name: AI Security Red Team Assessment
description: MITRE ATLAS techniques demonstrated or verified during the local AI security red team assessment. The layer is limited to activities supported by project evidence.

techniques.comment: Inference API access was tested through the local FastAPI /predict endpoint.
FGSM and PGD adversarial examples were successfully crafted against the MNIST model.
Adversarial examples were verified by submitting them to the deployed local inference API.
A controlled model-file tampering test demonstrated the model-integrity threat and the resulting integrity-check rejection.
